description: This PHP source file defines the CompletedPerformanceReviewModel class, which represents a data model for completed performance reviews within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for review details, status, ratings, comments, and review periods, and utilizes traits and annotations for serialization and API schema generation.
